clientRequest: Lets implement a generic feature to do disarm/shove/grapple automation. The 3 actions are manovers that all creatures can do and are based on Athletics vs Athletics or Acrobatics. The workflow must be: - Attacker select a target - Attacker uses the feature - Owner of attacker and attacked get prompt to roll check (The attacked chooses what they'll roll, Allows all kind of visibility, Can use other modules already provided)

review.summary: Revisão semântica após mega revisão do Agentic Design System (P-011) e migração Vertical Slices (P-003/P-012): dialogs e chat cards de combat-maneuvers, temporal-synchrony, critical-encounter, jump e prepare-spells-reminder migrados para classes canônicas (.et-dialog, .et-maneuver-card, .et-temporal-chat-card) sem inline style e sem cores hexadecimais hardcoded; nenhum conflito de domínio entre combat-maneuvers e endless-tower-design-system.
